changes.text: This entry is an EXAMPLE of the shape. The shell skips it; the first real entry, written at the first push under docs/agents/whats-new.md, replaces it.

A Major change says what the recipient must DO, in one line, because their setup degrades if they do not: a config key was renamed, a file the shell writes changed shape, a keybind now does something else.
Everything that is not an action is Minor, however much work it was: features, fixes, polish, visual changes.
